title: Implement repository-native trend, anticipation and closed observation loop

effects.description: Implement deterministic repository observation over issues, pull requests, branches, commits, tags, releases, workflow runs, jobs, checks, artifacts, comments, reviews, labels, Zenodo events and Authority/Mirror state.
Materialize forward-only verified observations with timestamps, revision bindings and SHA-256 state digests.
Compute state differences and discrete derivatives; distinguish activity from productive progress.
Select exactly one canonical minimal deterministic next effect from transition ordering rules.
Dispatch through the declared executor capability and automatically schedule a subsequent observation.
Expose equivalent GitHub-native and RCP projections for current state, history, trends, derivatives and next effect.
Bind the canonical anticipation digest into Zenodo metadata/evidence and IETF draft/render provenance without claiming external publication before receipts exist.
Run conformance tests proving the planner/assistant implementation is replaceable without changing canonical semantics.
Promote green Authority state and verify compatible Mirror projection and digest.

completion_condition: All mandatory gates green on the exact head, Authority merged, Mirror digest verified, publication projections bound, and next Work Unit materialized.
